roadmap.title: Open the island
roadmap.description: Solve the four mandatory Beach puzzles, shape the golden key, lower the drawbridge, and cross it.

roadmap.title: Unlock navigation and equipment
roadmap.description: Open the Map Room, then use its coordinates to find a backpack and hip bag for the group.

roadmap.title: Activate transport and explore
roadmap.description: Start the trains and chairlift, unlock the Yellow Tunnel, then use the travel network for the highest point, outer wall, and metallic makeover.

roadmap.title: Finish both endings
roadmap.description: Complete the main finale, then solve the remaining red and purple puzzles and use the final key to complete the hidden ending.

achievements.summary: Lower and cross the opening @loc{drawbridge} by completing the four Beach puzzles and shaping their golden key.

guide.context: The four opening Beach puzzles are mandatory because the raised drawbridge blocks access to the island's later puzzle network.

steps.text: Leave the tutorial through the large archway and reach the Beach control panel at coordinates 3550, 1100.
Complete the nearby crane, spyglass, blue-house symbol, and green-scaffolding switch puzzles to collect four red control-panel pieces.
Place all four red pieces in the Beach panel, take the released golden key, and follow the revealed arrows through all five key cutters.
Insert the shaped key into the grey panel above the stairs, wait for the drawbridge to lower, and walk across it.

achievements.summary: Use the @loc{Red Tower} key to open the @loc{Map Room} at coordinates 3560, 1425, then enter and approach the map.

guide.context: The Red Tower route becomes available after the drawbridge and provides the map needed to navigate later tower coordinates efficiently.

steps.text: After crossing the drawbridge, climb to the @loc{Red Tower} at coordinates 3670, 1400.
Complete any five accessible island puzzles, place their red rewards in the Red Tower panel, and collect the golden key released behind it.
Take the golden key downstairs and follow the arrows through all five key cutters until it fits the Map Room lock.
Go to the blue @loc{Map Room} at coordinates 3560, 1425, insert the shaped key beside the door, enter, and approach the map display.

achievements.summary: Activate the @loc{chairlift station} at coordinates 3950, 1950 with the shaped Green Tower key, then ride a moving chair.

guide.context: Puzzle targets and score requirements scale for two-, three-, and four-player groups, but the Green Tower key route is otherwise unchanged.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Green Tower} at coordinates 3930, 1900; the main chairlift station stands immediately beside it at 3950, 1950.
Complete any five accessible puzzles, place their red rewards in the Green Tower panel, and take the golden key.
Follow the cutter arrows from the tower door through all five key cutters, ending near the chairlift station.
Insert the shaped key inside the station, wait for the chairs to begin moving, board one, and remain seated while it travels.

achievements.summary: Start the island's trains with the shaped Blue Tower key at coordinates 3380, 1740, then board any moving train.

guide.context: One station lock activates the red, green, and yellow trains together; all three then circulate continuously in the same direction.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Blue Tower} at coordinates 3540, 1850.
Complete any five accessible puzzles, load their red rewards into the Blue Tower panel, and collect the golden key.
Use all five arrow-marked key cutters to shape the golden key, then follow the last arrow to the main train station at coordinates 3380, 1740.
Insert the shaped key into the station slot, wait for all three trains to start, and board the red, green, or yellow train for a moving ride.

achievements.summary: Shape the Yellow Tower key, unlock the @loc{Yellow Tunnel} at coordinates 3500, 1620, and walk through its entrance.

guide.context: The Yellow Tower is a late-game route whose tunnel also opens access to the metallic paint used for Big Makeover.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Yellow Tower} at coordinates 3310, 1560.
Complete any five accessible puzzles, place their red rewards in the Yellow Tower panel, and take the released golden key.
Follow the arrow chain through five key cutters; the final cutter stands near the Yellow Tunnel entrance.
Go southeast to coordinates 3500, 1620, insert the shaped key into the slot on the entrance's right side, and walk inside the opened @loc{Yellow Tunnel}.

achievements.summary: Go beyond the @loc{wall} associated with Big Wall until the Steam achievement unlocks.

guide.context: Big Wall is separate from Big Walk: crossing the opening drawbridge completes Big Walk but does not complete this wall objective.

steps.text: Locate the in-world @loc{wall} used by the Big Wall objective during group exploration.
Move beyond that wall and continue until Big Wall unlocks.

achievements.summary: Finish Big Walk's main game and remain in the session until Big Goodbye unlocks.

guide.context: Big Goodbye is the main ending; Big Game is a separate full-completion ending that uses additional red and purple puzzle rewards.

steps.text: Continue completing Big Walk's main group objectives until the game's ending becomes available.
Complete the main ending and remain in the session until Big Goodbye unlocks.

achievements.summary: After Big Goodbye, complete Big Walk's remaining postgame content and finish the full-completion ending to unlock Big Game.

guide.context: @warn{Finish an opened postgame puzzle room before ending the session}; an incomplete room may become inaccessible after reloading the host's save.

steps.text: Unlock Big Goodbye by completing the main game.
Continue in the same journey and complete every remaining main-world and postgame puzzle objective.
Complete the full-completion ending that becomes available and remain in the session until Big Game unlocks.

achievements.summary: Reach the highest point in Big Walk to unlock Big Climb.

guide.context: Big Climb is a height-based exploration objective rather than a reward for completing a colored tower panel.

steps.text: Explore the island's elevations and reach the game's highest point until Big Climb unlocks.

achievements.summary: Beyond the @loc{Yellow Tunnel}, reach the metallic paint palette and have another player coat your avatar with metallic paint.

guide.context: Your avatar cannot apply paint to itself, so a teammate must perform the final metallic makeover after the late-game tunnel is open.

steps.text: Complete the Yellow Tower route and unlock the @loc{Yellow Tunnel}.
Follow the tunnel to the dance room, take the rear-left corridor, continue as the walls change from grey to red, and turn right into the red passage at the green junction.
Continue to the giant red staircase and descend to the metallic paint palette beyond it.
Have a teammate select metallic paint and apply it to your avatar until Big Makeover unlocks.

achievements.summary: At the blue bag shelter southwest of the Red Tower at coordinates 1380, 3750, have another player attach the yellow @item{backpack} to you.

guide.context: Players cannot equip bags onto themselves; a teammate must attach the backpack, which can be worn together with a hip bag.

steps.text: Reach coordinates 1380, 3750, southwest of the @loc{Red Tower}, and enter the blue circular shelter with the short ramp.
Have a teammate pick up the yellow @item{backpack} hanging inside the shelter.
Stand facing the teammate and have them aim at your body until the attachment marker appears, then attach the backpack to your avatar.

achievements.summary: At coordinates 1860, 3750 northwest of the Green Tower, have another player attach the yellow @item{hip bag} to your hip.

guide.context: Hip bags use a separate attachment point from backpacks, allowing the same player to wear both and carry an additional item.

steps.text: Reach coordinates 1860, 3750, northwest of the @loc{Green Tower}, and enter the blue bag shelter on the mountainside.
Have a teammate pick up the triangular yellow @item{hip bag} inside the shelter.
Stand facing the teammate and have them aim at your hip until the attachment marker appears, then attach the bag to your avatar.
